description: This file defines utility functions in a static enum 'GatewayDiscoveryHelpers' for handling gateway discovery, URL resolution, and host validation within the OpenClaw project. It provides methods to resolve service hosts, determine endpoints, generate SSH targets, and construct URLs with security considerations.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost(for:)
methods.description: Resolves the service host from a DiscoveredGateway object.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost(_:)
methods.description: Trims and validates a host string.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint(for:)
methods.description: Returns the host and port tuple for a given gateway.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint(serviceHost:servicePort:)
methods.description: Validates and returns a host/port tuple from given parameters.

methods.name: sshTarget(for:)
methods.description: Generates an SSH target string based on the gateway's host and SSH port.

methods.name: directUrl(for:)
methods.description: Constructs a direct URL to the gateway using its host and port.

methods.name: directGatewayUrl(serviceHost:servicePort:)
methods.description: Constructs a secure URL (ws or wss) based on the gateway's service endpoint.

methods.name: trimmed(_:)
methods.description: Helper to trim whitespace from a string.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost(_:)
methods.description: Determines if a host string is a loopback address.
